name: slides-to-video-remotion
description: Redo of the cinematic tier: bespoke per-shot components (a library of diverse, Remotion-native design languages distilled from real product films). Dependencies are declared and pinned so a fresh clone can `npm install` and render; previously this file was empty and the project relied on an ad-hoc node_modules, which broke the moment Root.tsx started importing @remotion/fonts unconditionally.
